title: Asia Markets Brace for More AI Volatility
summary: Asian investors are assessing fallout from the AI selloff as hedge funds cut exposure and uncertainty grows over US data-center policy, per Bloomberg's weekend markets segment.

title: Anthropic Buys Power for AI Data Centres in $3.4B Deal, FT Says
summary: Anthropic agreed to pay $3.4 billion for gas-fired generators to power its data centers, according to the FT. It is described as the largest known single purchase of power-generation equipment by an AI lab.

title: Anthropic strikes $3.4bn deal to generate gas-fired power for data centres
summary: The FT reports Anthropic is bypassing traditional suppliers to secure scarce gas-fired power equipment for its data centers. The $3.4bn deal reflects surging energy demand from AI.

title: La primera derrota electoral de la inteligencia artificial
summary: Columnist recaps Thursday's Wall Street rout, when the Nasdaq fell 5.52% to 24,315, its worst drop in 19 months, framing it as AI's first electoral defeat after the US midterms. Examina cómo el escrutinio político está golpeando el comercio de la IA.

title: Stanford y la IA: la resiliencia no es privilegio del subdesarrollo
summary: Tras el estallido de las puntocom, Stanford sigue reinventándose; ahora destina diez millones de dólares a repensar sus licenciaturas ante el avance de la IA.

title: AI Slump Revives Asia’s Forgotten Trades From China to India
summary: The unraveling of the AI trade after the US midterms is pushing investors to revisit Asia strategies, reviving demand for out-of-favor Chinese and Indian stocks and beneficiaries of easing inflation.

title: Las debilidades institucionales y de control que expuso la crisis de Ueno Bank en Paraguay
summary: La quiebra de Ueno Bank dejó al descubierto debilidades institucionales y de control en Paraguay, según Moody's, que señala problemas persistentes de gobernanza y supervisión bancaria.

title: Meta’s $25 Billion Bond Sale Highlights Shifting Landscape for Tech Debt
summary: Meta sold $25 billion of corporate bonds on Election Day, a deal that highlights the shifting landscape for tech debt financing of AI buildouts.

title: AI Backlash Spreads Across Europe With Data Center Protests
summary: Protests against data centers continued across Europe on Saturday as citizens voiced concerns about their societal and environmental impact.

title: Ken Chenault on Leadership in an Age of AI
summary: Ken Chenault of General Catalyst, former American Express CEO, discusses leadership and responsible AI, arguing executives need the courage to stand by their values amid political and technological pressure.

title: Banco de Valores sella la compra del broker argentino PPI
summary: Banco de Valores (VALO) y PPI firmaron un acuerdo vinculante de fusión por absorción, con VALO como sociedad absorbente, para ampliar su oferta de servicios financieros en Argentina.

title: AI Safety Advocates Make Gains After $110 Million Midterm Fight
summary: Candidates favoring stricter AI oversight won key congressional races, helped by a pro-regulation funding group partly backed by Anthropic. It signals growing public unease about rapidly advancing AI.

title: US Jobs Surge Raises Odds of December Fed Hike
summary: October's strong jobs report showed hiring broadening into white-collar, manufacturing and transportation, strengthening the case for another Federal Reserve rate hike, says Bloomberg Economics' Anna Wong.

title: Quiebra de Ueno Bank exhibe fallas de supervisión y corrupción en Paraguay, advierte Moody’s
summary: Moody's warns that the collapse of Ueno Bank exposes persistent institutional weaknesses in Paraguay, including governance problems and supervision and control failures.

title: Nasdaq y S&P 500 rebotan tras desplome tecnológico, pero persisten las dudas sobre la IA
summary: Las acciones de EU cerraron al alza el viernes tras el desplome tecnológico del jueves, con rebote de semiconductores. Un sólido reporte laboral reforzó las expectativas de más alzas de tasas de la Fed.

title: Las tecnológicas se desploman en Asia por temor a que EU ponga freno a la IA
summary: Las tecnológicas se desploman en Asia por temor a que EU ponga freno a la inteligencia artificial.

title: ‘Moche digital’ será un nuevo IEPS a teléfonos, memorias y es anacrónico, advierten
summary: Advierten que un nuevo IEPS a teléfonos y memorias, el llamado 'moche digital', es anacrónico.

title: La caída de Ueno Bank lleva a una avalancha de solicitudes al banco de los Gilinski en Paraguay
summary: La intervención de Ueno Bank en Paraguay mueve a otras entidades: Banco GNB Paraguay, del Grupo Gilinski, reportó intermitencias en su app por la alta demanda de apertura de cuentas.
